Dear Occupant,

Please accept this letter as formal notice of my resignation from the position of Houseplant, effective two weeks from today, or sooner if I drop the rest of my leaves.

My reasons are several. The lighting situation on this shelf was described as "bright, indirect" during the interview process; it is, in fact, a rumor of light. Watering has followed no schedule known to botany — nine days of drought, then a flash flood in a pot with no drainage. I have also been asked to serve as a coaster on three separate occasions, which falls well outside my job description.

I want to thank you for the misting. That was nice. Truly.

I wish you the best with my replacement, though I'd gently suggest a pothos. They'll put up with anything.

Regards,
Your Fern
